title: Is it the AI or the inbox? Code, pre-registered protocol and text-free results
description:
Code, the frozen pre-registered protocol (with every logged deviation) and the text-free results of the study "Is it the AI or the inbox?". The study asks whether phishing-email detectors raise false alarms on legitimate email written with graded AI assistance, separating style, content and source. It also tests mitigations from both sides.

Version 1 is the protocol snapshot. It was archived before the single confirmatory analysis (notebook 07), so that the analysis plan is independently timestamped. Later versions add the confirmatory results and the paper package.

The archive contains no email text, raw or generated. Code is MIT-licensed. Results and documents are under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-CC-BY-4.0.md).
notes: Kaggle notebooks run in one pinned image; every run manifest records parameters, environment and SHA-256 hashes.
